blocks.text: JUDGE OF ISRAEL · THE TRIBES OF ISRAEL
Othniel. The first judge: eight years under Cushan-rishathaim, then forty years of rest.
LED ISRAELi
Not given "The land had rest forty years"; then Othniel died
TRIBE
Judah (of Caleb's Kenizzite family)
IN THE LINE
3rd of 15
SCRIPTURE SAYS
“He took Kirjath-sepher (Debir) and received Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife.”
PROPHETS
None named
THE TRIBES OF ISRAEL: 15 RULERS MOSES → SAMUEL
THE CYCLE
Forgetting, oppression, a cry, a deliverer, rest
1 · FORGOT GOD Israel "did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves". Judges 3:7
2 · OPPRESSED: CHUSHAN-RISHATHAIM, KING OF MESOPOTAMIA, 8 YEARS The LORD sold them into his hand, and they served him eight years. Judges 3:8
3 · CRIED OUT "The children of Israel cried unto the LORD." Judges 3:9
4 · DELIVERED Othniel went out to war and "his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim". Judges 3:9–10
5 · REST The land had rest 40 years. Judges 3:11
SUCCESSION
Before and after
WHAT SCRIPTURE SAYS
What Scripture says of him
He took Kirjath-sepher (Debir) and received Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife. Joshua 15:15–17 Judges 1:11–13
"The LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother." Judges 3:9
"The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war." Judges 3:10
In David's time the captain for the twelfth month was "Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel". 1 Chronicles 27:15

What the nation did

ON THE WORLD STAGE
The powers of the day
MESOPOTAMIA (KJV)
Chushan-rishathaim
DATES DIFFER
When was it?
SCRIPTURE'S OWN NUMBERS
No years given
Eight years of oppression and forty of rest (Judges 3:8, 3:11). No year BC is given; see the group's note on the judges' chronology.
His younger brother
Origen, Theodoret, Rashi and others, as listed by Moore; Keil (1865); Moore (1895)
Judges 1:13 and 3:9 call Othniel "Caleb's younger brother"; Keil reads the Hebrew accents this way, and Moore says the words "who was younger than he" favour it.[7][21]
His nephew, the son of Caleb's brother Kenaz
The Greek (LXX, Codex Vaticanus), Calvin, Ewald, Reuss and others, as listed by Moore
"The son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb" (Joshua 15:17) can make Kenaz the brother; 1 Chronicles 4:13 counts Othniel among "the sons of Kenaz".[21]
IN SCRIPTURE
Every passage
CHAPTERS · 5
Joshua 15 Judges 1 Judges 3 1 Chronicles 4 1 Chronicles 27
PASSAGES · 5
Joshua 15:15–19 Judges 1:11–15 Judges 3:7–11 1 Chronicles 4:13 1 Chronicles 27:15
WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Scripture gives no year BC for Othniel and says nothing of his rule beyond the war and the forty years of rest.
Judges 3 does not name his tribe; his family belongs to Caleb, who received land "among the children of Judah" (Joshua 15:13).
IDENTIFICATIONS THIS PAGE RELIES ON

From the textThe site's family data, from STEP Bible, makes Kenaz Othniel's father and Caleb his uncle. The verses can be read either way (see the open question). Joshua 15:17 Judges 1:13 1 Chronicles 4:13
